title: 中子散射儀~Neutron-scattering instruments
focus: 緩速器、中子導管、斬波器飛行時間、三軸譜儀、³He 偵測效率與計數統計的儀器工程~Instrument engineering of moderators, neutron guides, chopper time of flight, triple-axis spectrometers, ³He detection efficiency and counting statistics
summary: 從中子的德布羅意波長與毫電子伏特能量出發，說明反應爐與散裂源如何經緩速器產生熱與冷中子，再把超鏡導管、斬波器飛行時間、三軸譜儀的單色器與分析器、³He 偵測器效率、釩標準歸一化與背景計數統計整合成一份可驗收的中子散射儀工程紀錄。~Starting from the de Broglie wavelength and millielectronvolt energy of neutrons, the course shows how reactors and spallation sources produce thermal and cold neutrons through moderators, then integrates supermirror guides, chopper time of flight, triple-axis monochromators and analysers, ³He detector efficiency, vanadium normalisation and background counting statistics into an acceptance-ready neutron-scattering instrument record.

units.anchor: 熱中子與冷中子能譜~Thermal and cold neutron spectrum
units.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算~Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion
units.mechanism: 中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。散射長度隨同位素不規則變化，氫與氘的差異讓軟物質可以做對比變換。熱中子的波長約 1 到 2 Å，與原子間距相當，能量約數十 meV，與聲子和磁激發相當，所以同一束中子能同時量結構與動力學，這是中子散射儀存在的物理理由。~Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force; they also carry a magnetic moment that senses unpaired-electron magnetism directly. Scattering lengths vary irregularly between isotopes, and the hydrogen–deuterium difference allows contrast variation in soft matter. Thermal neutrons have wavelengths of about 1 to 2 Å, comparable to interatomic spacings, and energies of tens of meV, comparable to phonons and magnetic excitations, so one beam probes structure and dynamics together, which is the physical reason neutron-scattering instruments exist.
units.model: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s]，E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]。λ = 1.798 Å 對應 v ≈ 2200 m/s、E ≈ 25.3 meV（室溫熱中子）；λ = 4 Å 的冷中子 v = 989 m/s、E ≈ 5.11 meV；λ = 1 Å 則 E ≈ 81.8 meV。波長加倍，速度減半而能量降為四分之一。~λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons); a 4 Å cold neutron has v = 989 m/s and E ≈ 5.11 meV; λ = 1 Å gives E ≈ 81.8 meV. Doubling the wavelength halves the speed and quarters the energy.
units.verify: 以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較；兩者差異應在 0.1% 以內，否則要檢查飛行距離量測或單色器角度零點。~Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement; they should agree within 0.1%, otherwise check the flight-path survey or the monochromator angle zero.
units.failure: 把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。~Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption; for example a sample holder containing natural boron or cadmium absorbs most cold neutrons and the signal nearly vanishes.
units.misconception: 原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。~Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.

units.anchor: 散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω~Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω
units.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移~Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer
units.mechanism: 中子散射實驗量的是散射函數 S(Q, ω)：入射波向量 ki 與散射波向量 kf 的差就是動量轉移 Q，兩者動能之差就是樣品吸收或放出的能量 ħω。彈性散射只看 Q，給出結構；非彈性散射同時看 Q 與 ħω，給出聲子或磁子色散。因為 ki、kf 與散射角受運動學三角形約束，給定入射能量時並不是每一組 (Q, ω) 都能到達，儀器設計必須先確認目標激發落在可達區域內。~Neutron scattering measures the scattering function S(Q, ω): the difference between incident and scattered wavevectors ki and kf is the momentum transfer Q, and the difference in kinetic energy is the energy ħω absorbed or released by the sample. Elastic scattering looks at Q only and yields structure; inelastic scattering looks at Q and ħω together and yields phonon or magnon dispersions. Because ki, kf and the scattering angle are tied by the kinematic triangle, not every (Q, ω) pair is reachable for a given incident energy, so instrument design must first confirm that the target excitation lies in the accessible region.
units.model: 彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。λ = 2.359 Å、2θ = 90° 時 Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹，對應晶面間距 d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å；ħω = Ei − Ef。~For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]. For λ = 2.359 Å and 2θ = 90°, Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹, corresponding to a lattice spacing d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å; the energy transfer is ħω = Ei − Ef.
units.verify: 在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。~Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature.
units.failure: 入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。~With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split.
units.misconception: 只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。~With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.

units.anchor: 反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器~Reactor core, spallation target and moderator
units.title: 中子源與緩速器~Neutron sources and moderators
units.mechanism: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。兩者都必須經過緩速器，讓中子與輕原子核多次彈性碰撞降到熱平衡：室溫輕水或重水產生熱中子，約 20 K 的液態氫冷源把頻譜推向長波長。緩速器的材料、溫度、體積與耦合方式決定了中子頻譜峰值與脈衝寬度，對散裂源而言是通量與時間解析度的取捨。~Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons. Both need a moderator, in which repeated elastic collisions with light nuclei bring the neutrons to thermal equilibrium: room-temperature light or heavy water yields thermal neutrons, and a liquid-hydrogen cold source near 20 K shifts the spectrum to long wavelengths. Moderator material, temperature, volume and coupling set the spectral peak and the pulse width, which for a spallation source is a trade between flux and time resolution.
units.model: 從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。2 MeV 降到 25.3 meV：氫 ξ = 1，n ≈ 18；氘 ξ = 0.725，n ≈ 25；碳 ξ = 0.158，n ≈ 115，所以含氫材料最短距離內完成緩速，但氫的吸收也較大。~The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision. From 2 MeV to 25.3 meV: hydrogen with ξ = 1 needs n ≈ 18, deuterium with ξ = 0.725 needs n ≈ 25 and carbon with ξ = 0.158 needs n ≈ 115, so hydrogenous moderators slow neutrons in the shortest distance, though hydrogen also absorbs more.
units.verify: 在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。~Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary.
units.failure: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。~When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments.
units.misconception: 緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。~A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.

units.anchor: 超鏡中子導管~Supermirror neutron guide
units.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值~Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value
units.mechanism: 中子在大多數材料中的折射率略小於 1，以小角度入射鎳表面時會全反射，因此鍍鎳的玻璃或金屬矩形管能像光纖一樣把中子傳送到數十公尺外，讓儀器遠離爐心背景。超鏡在鎳層之上疊加數百到上千層厚度漸變的 Ni/Ti 多層膜，以布拉格反射把臨界角延伸到鎳的 m 倍。導管越長、m 值越高，能傳輸的發散角越大，但每次反射的損耗會隨反彈次數累積。~Neutrons see a refractive index slightly below one in most materials and are totally reflected from nickel at small grazing angles, so nickel-coated glass or metal rectangular guides transport them tens of metres like an optical fibre, moving instruments away from core background. Supermirrors stack hundreds to thousands of graded Ni/Ti multilayers on top of nickel, using Bragg reflection to extend the critical angle to m times that of nickel. Longer guides and higher m transport more divergence, but per-reflection loss accumulates with the number of bounces.
units.model: 天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。m = 3、λ = 4 Å 時 θc ≈ 1.2°。長 50 m、寬 50 mm 的導管，平均角度 0.6° 的中子反彈次數 N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5；每次反射率 0.95 時傳輸 ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58，降到 0.90 則只剩約 0.33。~Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]. For m = 3 and λ = 4 Å, θc ≈ 1.2°. In a 50 m long, 50 mm wide guide a neutron at a mean angle of 0.6° bounces N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5 times; at 0.95 reflectivity per bounce transmission is ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58, dropping to about 0.33 at 0.90.
units.verify: 每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。~Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation.
units.failure: 導管段之間的錯位或玻璃基板因長期輻照與真空失效而破裂，會在特定波長造成通量缺口，下游所有儀器同時受影響；只在單一波長檢查通量時，這種缺口很容易被漏掉。~Misalignment between guide sections, or glass substrates cracking after long irradiation or vacuum failure, punches wavelength-specific holes in the flux that hit every downstream instrument; checking flux at a single wavelength easily misses such gaps.
units.misconception: m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。~A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.

units.anchor: 盤式斬波器與飛行路徑~Disk choppers and flight path
units.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度~Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution
units.mechanism: 飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。散裂源本身是脈衝，反應爐則需以高速旋轉的盤式或費米斬波器把連續束切成短脈衝。波長解析度由脈衝時間寬度相對於總飛行時間的比例與飛行路徑不確定度決定；而相鄰脈衝的慢中子不能追上下一個脈衝的快中子，否則發生框架重疊，因此還需要帶寬斬波器限制每個脈衝的波長範圍。~Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy. A spallation source is pulsed by nature, while a reactor needs fast-spinning disk or Fermi choppers to cut the continuous beam into short pulses. Wavelength resolution is set by pulse width relative to total flight time and by path-length uncertainty; slow neutrons of one pulse must not overlap fast neutrons of the next, or frame overlap occurs, so bandwidth choppers limit the wavelength band of each pulse.
units.model: 飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。L = 20 m、λ = 4 Å 時 t ≈ 20.2 ms。60 Hz 源每框架 16.67 ms，可用帶寬 Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å。緩速器脈衝寬 100 µs 與路徑不確定 2 cm 時，Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%。~Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms. A 60 Hz source gives 16.67 ms per frame and a usable bandwidth Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å. With a 100 µs moderator pulse and a 2 cm path uncertainty, Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%.
units.verify: 以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。~Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame.
units.failure: 斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。~If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale; frame overlap places slow neutrons in the wrong time channels and creates spurious peaks.
units.misconception: 飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。~A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.

units.anchor: ³He 正比管與釩標準~³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard
units.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化~Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation
units.mechanism: 中子本身不游離，必須先被核反應轉成帶電粒子：³He(n,p)³H 反應釋放 764 keV，正比管收集質子與氚的游離電荷，伽瑪射線產生的訊號小很多，容易以脈高鑑別排除。³He 吸收截面與波長成正比，長波長效率高；但 ³He 供應短缺促使 ¹⁰B 塗層氣體偵測器與 ⁶Li 閃爍體等替代方案發展。各偵測器管的效率不同，必須以幾乎純非同調散射的釩樣品做歸一化，讓不同角度的強度可以比較。~Neutrons do not ionise directly and must first be converted into charged particles by a nuclear reaction: ³He(n,p)³H releases 764 keV, a proportional tube collects the ionisation of the proton and triton, and gamma rays give much smaller signals that pulse-height discrimination rejects. The ³He absorption cross-section is proportional to wavelength, so long wavelengths are detected efficiently; the ³He supply shortage has driven alternatives such as ¹⁰B-lined gas detectors and ⁶Li scintillators. Tubes differ in efficiency, so they are normalised against vanadium, an almost purely incoherent scatterer, to make intensities at different angles comparable.
units.model: 偵測效率 η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x)，吸收截面與波長成正比。10 bar、293 K 的 ³He 數密度 n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³，σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b，平均路徑 x ≈ 20 mm 時 η ≈ 93%；λ = 1 Å 時 σ ≈ 2966 b、η ≈ 77%；λ = 4 Å 時 η ≈ 99.7%。~Detection efficiency is η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x), with the absorption cross-section proportional to wavelength. ³He at 10 bar and 293 K has n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³; with σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b and a mean path x ≈ 20 mm, η ≈ 93%; at λ = 1 Å, σ ≈ 2966 b and η ≈ 77%; at λ = 4 Å, η ≈ 99.7%.
units.verify: 以中子源與伽瑪源分別量測每支管的脈高譜，設定在 764 keV 全能峰與壁效應肩部以下、伽瑪訊號以上的鑑別門檻；量測釩樣品的彈性散射強度並扣除空容器背景，得到每支管的相對效率表，與上次校正比較，變化超過 2% 的管要檢查高壓與氣體。~Record pulse-height spectra for every tube with a neutron source and a gamma source, and set the discriminator below the 764 keV full-energy peak and wall-effect shoulder but above the gamma signal; measure elastic scattering from vanadium, subtract the empty-can background to obtain a relative-efficiency table, compare with the last calibration, and check high voltage and gas for any tube that changed by more than 2%.
units.failure: 鑑別門檻設太低時伽瑪背景混入，非彈性弱訊號被淹沒；某支管漏氣或高壓偏移時效率下降，如果沒有定期釩歸一化，資料上會出現與角度相關的假強度變化，被誤讀為樣品織構。~With the discriminator too low gamma background leaks in and buries weak inelastic signals; a leaking tube or drifting high voltage lowers efficiency, and without regular vanadium normalisation the data show angle-dependent false intensity changes that are misread as sample texture.
units.misconception: 中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。~A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.

units.anchor: PG 單色器、分析器與濾片~PG monochromator, analyser and filter
units.title: 三軸譜儀整合與解析度~Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution
units.mechanism: 三軸譜儀以三個旋轉軸依序決定入射能量（單色器）、樣品取向與散射角、以及散射能量（分析器），可以在 (Q, ω) 空間中逐點量測任意路徑。熱導熱解石墨 PG(002) 晶體常用作單色器與分析器，並以彎曲晶面聚焦提高通量。固定 Ef = 14.7 meV 的設定可讓 PG 濾片有效抑制 λ/2 高次諧波。儀器解析度是一個四維橢球，其大小與方向由準直器、晶體鑲嵌度與散射幾何決定，量測聲子時必須讓橢球長軸沿色散方向才能得到尖銳的峰。~A triple-axis spectrometer uses three rotation axes in sequence to set the incident energy (monochromator), the sample orientation and scattering angle, and the scattered energy (analyser), measuring point by point along any path in (Q, ω) space. Pyrolytic graphite PG(002) crystals commonly serve as monochromator and analyser, with curved arrays focusing to raise flux. Fixing Ef = 14.7 meV lets a PG filter suppress the λ/2 harmonic effectively. The resolution is a four-dimensional ellipsoid whose size and orientation are set by collimators, crystal mosaic and scattering geometry, and a phonon peak is sharp only when the ellipsoid's long axis lies along the dispersion.
units.model: 固定散射能量 Ef = 14.7 meV 時，λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å、kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹；石墨 PG(002) 晶面間距 d = 3.355 Å，布拉格角 θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6°，所以分析器散射角 2θA ≈ 41.2°。同一角度也會反射 λf/2 的二次諧波，其能量為 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV，必須由 PG 濾片衰減。~With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹; graphite PG(002) has d = 3.355 Å, so the Bragg angle is θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6° and the analyser scattering angle is 2θA ≈ 41.2°. The same angle also reflects the λf/2 second harmonic, whose energy is 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV, and the PG filter must attenuate it.
units.verify: 以釩的非同調彈性散射掃描分析器角度，確定 Ef 的零點與能量寬度；以標準單晶的布拉格峰做 θ–2θ 與搖擺掃描量測 Q 解析度，並在已知聲子上以聚焦與反聚焦兩種幾何掃描，比較峰寬與 Cooper–Nathans 或 Popovici 解析度計算值。~Scan the analyser angle on incoherent elastic scattering from vanadium to fix the Ef zero and energy width; measure Q resolution with θ–2θ and rocking scans on Bragg peaks of a standard crystal, and scan a known phonon in focusing and defocusing geometries, comparing peak widths with Cooper–Nathans or Popovici resolution calculations.
units.failure: PG 濾片未放入或方向錯誤時，λ/2 中子在分析器上與 λ 同時滿足布拉格條件，非彈性掃描中出現來自高次諧波的假峰；解析度橢球與色散方向配錯時，真實的尖銳激發被量成寬而弱的鼓包。~Without the PG filter, or with it misoriented, λ/2 neutrons satisfy the analyser Bragg condition along with λ and create spurious harmonic peaks in inelastic scans; with the resolution ellipsoid mismatched to the dispersion, a genuinely sharp excitation appears as a broad, weak hump.
units.misconception: 三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。~Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction.

units.anchor: 屏蔽、背景監測與驗收紀錄~Shielding, background monitoring and acceptance record
units.title: 背景、計數統計與試車交接~Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff
units.mechanism: 中子散射的訊號通常每秒只有幾個計數，背景來自爐心或散裂靶的快中子與伽瑪、相鄰儀器、樣品環境與空氣散射，因此背景控制直接決定實驗所需時間。屏蔽以混凝土、鋼與含硼或含鋰材料組成，並以吸收材內襯樣品區與偵測器箱，屬於設施輻射安全設計，由專責單位依法規驗證。儀器交接要以標準樣品證明波長刻度、解析度、偵測器歸一化與訊雜比，並把計數統計換算成使用者實際需要的量測時間。~Neutron-scattering signals are often only a few counts per second, with background from fast neutrons and gammas of the core or spallation target, neighbouring instruments, sample environment and air scattering, so background control directly sets how long an experiment takes. Shielding combines concrete, steel and boron- or lithium-bearing absorbers lining the sample area and detector tank, and is part of the facility radiation-safety design verified by the responsible group under regulation. Instrument handoff must prove wavelength calibration, resolution, detector normalisation and signal-to-background with standard samples, and turn counting statistics into the measurement time users will actually need.
units.model: 若樣品（訊號 S 加背景 B）與純背景各量測 t 秒，扣除後淨訊號的相對誤差 = √(S + 2B)/(S·√t)。S = 2 cps、B = 1 cps 時要達 1% 需 t = (√4/(2×0.01))² = 10 000 s ≈ 2.8 h；背景降到 0.2 cps 時只需約 6000 s ≈ 1.7 h，同樣精度省下 40% 的束流時間。~Counting sample (signal S plus background B) and background for t seconds each, the relative error of the net signal is √(S + 2B)/(S·√t). For S = 2 cps and B = 1 cps, 1% needs t = (√4/(2×0.01))² = 10 000 s ≈ 2.8 h; lowering background to 0.2 cps needs only about 6000 s ≈ 1.7 h, saving 40% of the beamtime for the same precision.
units.verify: 在束流關閉、主光閘開啟但樣品位置放置強吸收體、以及正常量測三種狀態下記錄偵測器計數率，分離設施背景、束流相關背景與樣品訊號；以釩、標準粉末與已知單晶完成波長、解析度與效率校正，並把背景率、計數率與預估量測時間表寫入交接文件。~Record detector count rates with beam off, with the main shutter open but a strong absorber at the sample position, and in normal measurement, to separate facility background, beam-related background and sample signal; complete wavelength, resolution and efficiency calibration with vanadium, a standard powder and a known single crystal, and file background rates, count rates and a predicted measurement-time table in the handoff record.
units.failure: 相鄰儀器更換設定或光閘開啟時背景跳升，若沒有持續監測背景，使用者會把背景變化誤認為樣品隨溫度的相變；樣品環境中未加吸收內襯的鋁件散射，會在特定 Q 位置產生假的布拉格峰。~When a neighbouring instrument changes configuration or opens its shutter the background jumps, and without continuous background monitoring users mistake the change for a temperature-driven phase transition in the sample; unshielded aluminium parts in the sample environment scatter and produce false Bragg peaks at specific Q.
units.misconception: 只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。~With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time.

example: 冷中子飛行時間能譜練習：入射波長 λi = 4 Å，vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s，Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV。樣品到偵測器 L2 = 3.0 m，彈性中子飛行時間 t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms。若中子在樣品激發 ħω = 1.0 meV 的激發，Ef ≈ 4.11 meV，λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å，vf ≈ 887 m/s，t2 ≈ 3.382 ms，比彈性晚約 0.349 ms。彈性能量解析度 ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2，取等效時間不確定 Δt = 15 µs，ΔE/E ≈ 0.99%，ΔE ≈ 51 µeV。若源頻率 60 Hz、源到偵測器總路徑 23 m，4 Å 中子總飛行 23.26 ms 已超過 16.67 ms 框架，帶寬斬波器必須把波長範圍限制在約 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å 以內。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際儀器規格。~Cold-neutron time-of-flight exercise: incident wavelength λi = 4 Å gives vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s and Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV. With sample-to-detector distance L2 = 3.0 m the elastic flight time is t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms. If the neutron creates a ħω = 1.0 meV excitation in the sample, Ef ≈ 4.11 meV, λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å, vf ≈ 887 m/s and t2 ≈ 3.382 ms, arriving about 0.349 ms after the elastic line. The elastic energy resolution is ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2; taking an effective timing uncertainty Δt = 15 µs gives ΔE/E ≈ 0.99% and ΔE ≈ 51 µeV. At a 60 Hz source with a 23 m total source-to-detector path, a 4 Å neutron takes 23.26 ms, longer than the 16.67 ms frame, so the bandwidth choppers must restrict the band to about 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real instrument's specification.
history: 1940 年代後期 Shull 在橡樹嶺石墨反應爐以中子繞射解析晶體與磁結構，1950 年代 Brockhouse 在加拿大 Chalk River 發展三軸譜儀量測聲子，兩人因此共同獲得 1994 年諾貝爾物理獎。1967 年法德合作成立勞厄—朗之萬研究所（ILL），其高通量反應爐於 1971 年運轉並率先大規模使用冷源與中子導管；1976 年 Mezei 提出超鏡，大幅提高導管傳輸；橡樹嶺散裂中子源 SNS 於 2006 年產生第一批中子，代表以脈衝散裂源與飛行時間儀器為主的新世代設施。~In the late 1940s Shull used neutron diffraction at the Oak Ridge Graphite Reactor to solve crystal and magnetic structures, and in the 1950s Brockhouse developed the triple-axis spectrometer at Chalk River in Canada to measure phonons, sharing the 1994 Nobel Prize in Physics. France and Germany founded the Institut Laue-Langevin in 1967, whose high-flux reactor started in 1971 and pioneered large-scale use of cold sources and neutron guides; Mezei proposed the supermirror in 1976, greatly raising guide transmission; and the Spallation Neutron Source at Oak Ridge produced its first neutrons in 2006, typifying a generation of pulsed spallation facilities built around time-of-flight instruments.
